title: Crispy Cornmeal Chicken Bites
description: A twist on traditional Chinese-style fried chicken, this recipe uses cornmeal for a crispy coating.
instructions: 1. In a medium bowl, whisk together soy sauce, paprika, and 1 tablespoon water.
2. Add the chicken to the marinade and toss to coat. Refrigerate for at least 30 minutes.
3. Preheat the oil in a deep frying pan or a deep fryer to 350°F (175°C).
4. In a shallow dish, mix together cornmeal and a pinch of salt.
5. Remove the chicken from the marinade, allowing any excess to drip off.
6. Dredge the chicken pieces in the cornmeal mixture, shaking off any excess.
7. Fry the chicken in batches until golden brown and cooked through, about 5-7 minutes.
8. Drain the chicken on paper towels and serve hot with pilaf.
